Arzt.et: From Middle High German arzet, arzāt, from Old High German arzāt, from Latin archīāter (“physician”), from Ancient Greek ἀρχῐᾱτρός (arkhĭātrós), from ἀρχι- (arkhi-) + ἰατρός (iatrós).

Ärztin.et: From Middle High German arzātīn, arzātinne. Equivalent to Arzt + -in, with umlaut.

Arznei.et: From Middle High German arzenie. By surface analysis, Arzt + -ei. Compare Dutch artsenij.

Arzneimittel.et: From Arznei + Mittel, since the end of the 16th century.
